newsitem.title: THAILAND: Bangkok Bank Q3 net refects loan quality.
newsitem.headline: Bangkok Bank Q3 net refects loan quality.

text.p: Bangkok Bank Plc's 9.9 percent third quarter profit growth was in line with market expectations and reflected the largest Thai bank's prudent lending policy, analysts said on Thursday.
Bangkok Bank told the Stock Exchange of Thailand its net profit rose to 5.12 billion baht in the July/September quarter from 4.66 billion a year ago.

"It's more a question of quality rather than quantity. Lower growth this year reflects a conservative stance. Their provisioning is very strong," said James Marshall, head of research at Capital Nomura Securities.
